reviewer.name: hill_scientific_review
reviewer.independence_basis: Separate agent run from model/source/interface authors /root, /root/hill_source and /root/hill_interface; personally read and hashed five original HTML sources, inspected exact equations and solver semantics, and reproduced source algebra plus independent reviewer KKT/closed-form and saved numerical/hash checks. No compiled calls, builds, authorship or invented identity.

scope: Abaqus2025 documented 3D Hill associative perfect plasticity plus isotropic elasticity; Atlas mathematical backward Euler, fixed aligned material/spatial axes, dry total Cauchy stress, small strain, compression-positive Mandel, strictly positive Hill coefficients. Bounded frozen default and coefficient-variant cases and native/Wasm material-point integrate API; 31 cases/41 increments repeated twice per backend. Source-freeze-v2 and build-receipt exact identities. Browser/main atlas packaging and live delivery remain separate E6-E8 gates.
limitations: Illustrative constants and frozen cases qualify no broad parameter/history region, calibration, experimental prediction or vendor numerical implementation.
No hardening, viscosity/creep, pore coupling, damage, anisotropic elasticity, finite rotation/spin, evolving material axes, FE host, public tangent or general mixed-control guarantee.
Gamma is increment-local, not accumulated plastic strain/PEEQ. Explicit initial yield tolerance is normalized phi/p_ref <=1e-10; machine bounds are not empirical ranges.

Original negative.mjs blanket full-state-echo gate fails for parameter prevalidation errors without state and remains failed. Distinct V2 diagnostic and actual material-failure rollback pass; caller must preserve committed state on prevalidation error.
Actual browser packaging, desktop/mobile qualification, ordinary atlas/database and live delivery are subsequent gates not certified by this scientific review.
Private vendor originals have no established redistribution license; full hash/build reproduction requires recorded private and isolated local paths.

checklist.reason: Five readable exact-hash Abaqus2025 governing HTML sources inspected, with complete elastic/plastic closure, exact version and private retention.
Source quadratic/associated flow, Mandel conversion, elastic closure and equivalent squared-potential BE KKT residual agree; numerical algorithm distinguished from vendor implementation.
Explicit v0.3 strain-path/small-strain/fixed aligned-frame/Mandel/compression-positive/total-Cauchy declarations and dimensions are consistent.
Complete ten-parameter/seven-state inventory, transient multiplier, positive convex subset, bounded examples and disclosed normalized initial yield tolerance are adequate.

Common solver reset/commit/rollback semantics and saved actual failed-material/recovery evidence pass; blanket full-state echo on prevalidation errors is explicitly excluded and original failure retained.
Independent source algebra and Decimal endpoint references verified with reviewer source KKT, pure-shear and isotropic closed forms; all saved prospective backend gates and exact repeats reproduced.
Exact common source and native/Wasm artifact hashes verified; bounded integrate API has 82 saved calls/backend and material-failure rollback; subsequent browser/live delivery excluded.
Fixed-axis dry small-strain positive-coefficient perfect-plastic model and frozen numerical scope are explicit; broad parameters, hardening/rate/rotation/FE and experiments excluded.
Exact sources/model/policy/reference/tools/build/raw failures/results and this independent reviewer evidence are hash-bound; reproduction and private-source rights limits disclosed.
